source_title: Lemon Squeezy Vs Gumroad Which Platform Is Right For You
snippet_primary: "Lemon Squeezy excels in handling subscriptions, abandoned carts, and email marketing but lacks a marketplace for additional exposure. Gumroad offers more visibility through its marketplace and robust community features, while also supporting a range of product types, including physical goods."
subject_exact: Comparación de Toolfolio: Lemon Squeezy destaca en suscripciones, carritos abandonados y email marketing pero sin marketplace; Gumroad con visibilidad vía marketplace, comunidad y soporte de más tipos de producto incluyendo bienes físicos
